list.name: sensor_type
list.label: Sensor Type
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT sensor_type FROM sensor_latest ORDER BY sensor_type

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket AS time, sensor_id, avg_value FROM sensor_stats_1min WHERE sensor_type = 'temperature' AND $__timeFilter(bucket) ORDER BY bucket
SELECT bucket AS time, sensor_id, avg_value FROM sensor_stats_1min WHERE sensor_type = 'humidity' AND $__timeFilter(bucket) ORDER BY bucket
SELECT bucket AS time, sensor_id, avg_value FROM sensor_stats_1min WHERE sensor_type = 'co2' AND $__timeFilter(bucket) ORDER BY bucket
SELECT bucket AS time, sensor_id, avg_value FROM sensor_stats_1min WHERE sensor_type = 'vibration' AND $__timeFilter(bucket) ORDER BY bucket

SELECT sensor_id, sensor_type, location, round(value::numeric, 2) AS value, unit, quality, last_seen FROM sensor_latest WHERE sensor_type ~ '^${sensor_type:regex}$' ORDER BY sensor_type, sensor_id LIMIT 100

SELECT sensor_type, COUNT(*) AS total_sensors, ROUND(AVG(value)::numeric, 2) AS avg_value, ROUND(MIN(value)::numeric, 2) AS min_value, ROUND(MAX(value)::numeric, 2) AS max_value FROM sensor_latest GROUP BY sensor_type ORDER BY sensor_type

SELECT sensor_id, sensor_type, location, last_seen, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - last_seen))::int AS seconds_ago FROM sensor_latest WHERE last_seen < now() - INTERVAL '2 minutes' ORDER BY last_seen ASC
